_about: Static checks run by fitcheck_lint and after every UI edit (PostToolUse hook). Each rule: id, pattern (JS regex), flags, message, fix, severity (error|warn|info). Optional: min (flag only when the pattern appears at least this many times in a file), unless (regex: skip the rule when the file also matches this). Add project rules in <project>/.drip/slop.json with the same shape.

rules.fix: Gradients are welcome: take their colours from the direction's palette, not the framework defaults.
Use the project's single icon family (icons_search), or no icon.
Write real copy for this product (drip_guide copy).
Use real figures from the user, or drop the stat.
Say what the product does, concretely (drip_guide copy).
Name the action: 'Start free trial', 'See pricing', 'Send invite'.

rules.message: Sparkles icon: the universal 'AI did this' tell.
rules.fix: Pick an icon that means something here, or none.

rules.message: transition: all animates layout properties and causes jank.
rules.fix: Transition only transform, opacity, colour (drip_guide motion).

rules.message: Focus outline removed with no focus-visible replacement.
Light grey text used a lot; likely under 4.5:1 on light backgrounds.
rules.fix: Check with palette_check; use a darker step for body text.

rules.message: Small uppercase eyebrow labels over many sections.
rules.fix: Use eyebrows rarely; let headings stand alone (drip_guide copy).
Move colours into tokens (CSS variables / Tailwind theme) from DESIGN.md.
Stick to the spacing scale (drip_guide layout).

rules.message: Lots of radius values in one file; check they follow one radius scale.
rules.fix: Pick 2-3 radii in DESIGN.md; nested radius = outer minus padding.
